name: gopherviz
description: See how your code runs as a pixel-art game, live while you type. Loops, if/switch, functions, recursion, classes, sorting, searching, stacks, queues, goroutines and the JS event loop in Go, JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, PHP, C++, C and Java. Your code is simulated, never executed.

colors.description: Background of the line the Gopher is running in the editor.
Left border of the line the Gopher is running in the editor.

gopherviz.realtime.description: Update the picture on every keystroke, without waiting for the file to be saved.

gopherviz.autoOpen.description: Open the panel automatically when the cursor first enters a block (loop, if, switch).

enumDescriptions: Editor tab (can be dragged beside or below the editor).
Bottom panel, next to the Terminal (buttons and output beside the picture).
gopherviz.location.description: Where the GopherViz panel lives. You can also pick it with the "GopherViz: Move panel…" command or the button in the panel title.

gopherviz.size.description: Picture size as a percentage of the available space. You can also drag the bottom-right corner of the picture (double-click: back to full size).

gopherviz.details.description: Show explanation text in the panel (block code, explanation, body/branches, variables, output, block list). By default the panel shows only the picture.

gopherviz.highlightLine.description: Highlight the line the Gopher is running right in the editor, in step with the panel animation.

gopherviz.codeLens.description: Show a "▶ Visualize" button above every block (function, loop, if, switch).

gopherviz.music.description: Background music (the theme chiptune, or your own music file if set).

enumDescriptions: Match the VS Code theme: light = Day, dark = Night
Starry dusk sky, moon and fireflies
Stone cave with flickering torches and crystals
Sunset beach: rolling waves, palm trees and gulls
gopherviz.theme.description: Stage background theme (the music changes with it).

gopherviz.pixelBg.description: Pixel-art background. Turn off for a smooth background (cubes, the Gopher and text stay pixelated).

day.description: Music file (mp3/ogg/wav) for the Day theme

night.description: Music file for the Night theme

cave.description: Music file for the Cave theme

beach.description: Music file for the Beach theme

gopherviz.musicFiles.markdownDescription: Your own music file per theme (full path, e.g. `C:\Music\lofi.mp3`). Themes left empty use their built-in chiptune.

gopherviz.binaryPath.description: Path to the gopherviz binary. Leave empty to use the one bundled with the extension.

gopherviz.ffmpegPath.description: Location of ffmpeg (e.g. C:\ffmpeg\bin\ffmpeg.exe) for saving recordings as MP4. Leave empty if ffmpeg is already on your PATH.

scripts.test: npm run build:bin && node scripts/build.mjs --test && node --test out/test/*.test.js
scripts.test:vscode: npm run build:bin && npm run compile && node scripts/test-vscode.mjs
scripts.package: npm run build:bin:all && npm run compile && vsce package --baseContentUrl https://github.com/siregaryedija/gopherviz/blob/main/vscode-extension/ --baseImagesUrl https://raw.githubusercontent.com/siregaryedija/gopherviz/main/vscode-extension/
